text:
The consecutive pair is Ann then Ben. Cara comes before Elif, Elif before Ann, and Ann before Hana. Gus comes after Ben, and Ann and Gus are at least three apart, so Gus is at least three slots after Ann.

The only pair that also leaves Dev before Gus and at least three from Ann, Ben, Cara, and Gus is Ann in 6 and Ben in 7. That places Gus in 9 and Hana in 8.

The first five slots are then fixed: Dev must be in 1 to stay three from both Cara and Ann; Finn must be in 2 to stay three from both Ben and Elif; Ivo must be in 3 to stay three from Ben and still precede Gus; Cara is in 4 and Elif in 5. Every other Ann–Ben placement breaks an order or a distance constraint.
